Main.dc.html.title: The rail, as it would be

brief.text:
A tool answers three questions and a tile name fuses all three: what it sounds like (voice), how it lands (head), whether it stays (keeps).

Heads have glyphs. Voices have names. You can draw a gesture; you cannot draw a sound.

hint.text: The middle board is live - click into it. Pick a head, pick a voice, watch the hand at the bottom. Two clicks, one choice each, no drawer.

openq.text:
Open, not decided:

- 53px (bottom board): where the voice goes
- keeps is three-way, not boolean
- match is the one head that refuses to decompose - it decides which material a mark reads, not where it lands
- voices live by nature? then a pot sweep moves every stroke painted with that voice
